name: Muro Horizontal — HP 1/3 Crítico
generation_strategy: IMAGEN INDIVIDUAL 1024×1024. Un solo muro centrado en canvas transparente. Strictly top-down 90°. Tight bbox crop → resize 128×32.

frames.prompt: A single top-down cartoon sci-fi wall barrier sprite, centered on a fully transparent background. Camera is STRAIGHT DOWN at 90 degrees — only the TOP FACE is visible, NO side face, NO front face, NO 3D perspective. The wall is a wide flat horizontal rectangle (approx 4:1 width-to-height ratio). CRITICALLY DAMAGED state — two impacts. Same dark armored steel surface but heavily damaged: TWO bold cartoon cracks crossing the full width, multiple corner chunks missing, surface warped and scorched. Thin wisps of dark cartoon smoke drift upward from the largest crack. The energy stripe along the bottom long edge is BRIGHT RED (#FF2222) with intense red bloom — the glow is unstable, pulsing. LED dots glow red. The wall barely holds together. Bold dark charcoal outline. Transparent background, nothing else.
frames.negative_prompt: side view, front face, isometric, any 3D perspective, realistic, photorealistic, pixel art, stone, sandy, undamaged, one crack only, green stripe, orange stripe, text, watermark, background scenery

phaser_config.notes: Stripe roja = crítico. Siguiente impacto destruye el muro.
